title: Saskatchewan’s largest health research project needs participants
desc: The Saskatchewan Cancer Agency is inviting adults across the province to participate in Healthy Future Sask, Saskatchewan’s largest health research project. Adults between the ages of 30 and 74 with a valid Saskatchewan health card are eligible to take part, regardless of their current health status or where they live in the province. Participants can enroll by completing an online questionnaire, with an optional in-person clinic visit also available. “This is an exciting opportunity for Saskatchewan residents to ensure that health research in our province reflects the people that live here,” Saskatchewan Cancer Agency Vice-President of Population Health, Quality and Research Karen Efthimiou said. title: Audrey Werro wins 800m in Birmingham as Keely Hodgkinson takes silver
desc: Keely Hodgkinson came up just short of a coveted European 800 metres title hat-trick after Swiss favourite Audrey Werro won their hotly-anticipated showdown in Birmingham as the British Olympic champion settled for silver. The Briton started quicker, but was overtaken by Werro on the back straight and could not be caught after the first 200m.
